full_name: Ileana Streinu | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Mathematics Frances B. Cashin Fellow Smith College
bio: Ileana Streinu’s current collaborative project with Ciprian S. Borcea aims to publish an accessible book presentation of new geometrical results, including techniques and insights related to protein folding, robot kinematics, and auxetic behavior in crystalline materials.
